Add server-side proxy for AI API calls

Converts to hosted Blazor WebAssembly with Server + Client + Shared projects:

- Server: ASP.NET Core backend with /api/ai/generate and /api/ai/test-key endpoints
- Client: Blazor WASM frontend \(moved from root\)
- Shared: Request/response models shared between Server and Client

The proxy solves CORS issues by making API calls from the server instead of browser.
Now both Anthropic and Ollama work without CORS configuration.
